description: This file defines a static generic class TypeProps<T> that determines whether the type T can be written atomically without risk of torn reads, based on type characteristics and ECMA specifications.

classes.name: TypeProps<T>
classes.description: Internal static class providing information on whether a type T can be written atomically.

methods.name: IsWriteAtomicPrivate
methods.description: Determines if type T can be written atomically based on type code and value type status.
